page.layout: One blank page with no printed text. Only paper discoloration, scattered specks and a dark scanner edge along the bottom and left side.
page.notes: The scan shows no printed text, no headings, no running head, no page number and no signature. The dark band at the bottom edge and the lighter strip at the lower left are the digitiser's scan border and the edge of the neighbouring page, not printed matter, so they are left out.
